snippet.description:
안녕하십니까 고캠입니다.

이번영상은 언양 작천정별빛야영장

작괘천 사이트 명당 6번데크에서

하루 쉬고왔습니다.

비올때 대형타프를 쳐서 넓은공간아래서

생활을 하시길 추천드립니다.

 해준 레시피라 개별량은 없습니다

앞다리살, 양파, 파, 다진마늘, 고추장,간장

 고춧가루, 설탕, 참기름 넣고 주물러준다음

30~1시간 숙성후  팬에 볶아서 드시면

en-US.description:
Hello, this is GoCam.

I've been to Haok Valley for 25 years.

The amount and quality of water are both disappointing because it didn't rain much,

but the situation seems to have improved compared to last year.

There is a flush toilet at the Madugyo parking lot,

and the left Haok Valley and the right Deokgol Valley are nice,

and the area in front of Byeolbit Minbak looks the best for water play.

Haok Valley is located at a high altitude and deep in the mountains,

so the temperature is 6-8 degrees lower than in the city.

I think it would be good to go to Haok Valley and heal

in a cool way.
